policy_status: Exploration under current scenario assumptions; original frozen-policy test evaluation is retained separately.

assumptions.physical_confirmation_assumption: Perfect reference for this simulation only; not measured human performance.
assumptions.missed_damage_basis: Direct student-specified assumption of EUR200 mean unrecovered loss per missed damage case at an ordinary rental return, focusing on minor bodywork. This replaces the earlier EUR300 times 80% calculation; do not apply the 80% factor again. Not an observed repair-price estimate.
assumptions.unit: One labelled photograph stands in for one return; no claim of full vehicle coverage.
assumptions.reviewer_basis: The student explicitly assumes that a human reviewing a photo correctly identifies all visible damage and dismisses every false damage alert: 100% sensitivity and 100% specificity. This is an idealised academic assumption, not measured human performance; it applies only to reviewed photos with known condition, not unshown vehicle areas.
assumptions.capacity_basis: No fixed daily time limit. The student treats staff time as a valued resource and time released for calls, emails and other duties. Workload is reported, not a constraint on threshold selection.
assumptions.incident_basis: Codex retains the earlier 5-minute report estimate as administrative handling time for every provisional incident, true or false. This handling does not independently reclassify the photo. A false incident costs that staff time; no automatic charge or additional compensation loss is assumed. Sensitivity analysis varies these estimates.
assumptions.workflow_basis: Student accepted automatic pass below lower threshold, human photo review in the middle band, and automatic provisional damage incident at/above upper threshold. Human-positive reviews also create incidents. No physical check and no automatic customer charge in this workflow.
assumptions.damage_scope_basis: Student assumes most damage reaching the ordinary return area is minor bodywork; major accidents, potentially involving towing, follow a separate incident process. This is a hypothetical business scope, not verified company practice or a filtered dataset.
assumptions.scope_description_es: Alcance supuesto: daños leves de chapa en devoluciones normales; los accidentes graves seguirían otro proceso. Los 200 € son una pérdida media hipotética por omisión. El dataset original también contiene daños graves y se conserva completo, por lo que no representa exactamente este alcance.

confusion_definition: Expected provisional damage incidents after simulated photo review; rows=true damage/undamaged, columns=incident/pass. FP is an unnecessary incident, not a customer charge.
limitations: Scores are uncalibrated, truncated below inference confidence .001.
Validation used for selection; these minima are optimistic, not test performance.
Photo reviewer accuracy is assumed. Automatic high-score incidents can be false positives even with a perfect reviewer in the middle band.
Incident handling time and false-incident losses are scenario estimates, not measured operations.
Current scenario was revised after viewing the original test; it has no new independent holdout evaluation.
Workload is cumulative expected staff time; no arrivals or queue simulation.
Single photo does not establish whole-vehicle condition or customer liability.
The current loss assumption targets minor bodywork at ordinary returns, but the unfiltered public dataset also contains severe damage; class labels do not provide severity-specific rates.
